def slugify(title):
	return title.strip().lower().replace(' ', '-')

def count_words(text, separator=' '):
	return len([word for word in text.split(separator) if word != ''])

def merge_settings(defaults, overrides):
	merged = dict(defaults)
	merged.update(overrides)
	return merged

def log_event(logger, event_name, payload):
	logger.info('%s %s', event_name, payload)

def send_invitation(mailer, address, template_name):
	mailer.send(address, template_name)

def normalise_headers(headers):
	return {name.lower(): value for name, value in headers.items()}
